description: Replaces pieces of an existing text file in the draft. Each `oldText` must appear exactly once, whitespace included, unless `replaceAll`. Edits apply in order, all or none. With `baseVersion` it fails (version_changed) if the file changed since you read it. New or binary files: neblla_upload_file. Waits in that env's draft until neblla_promote "save" with the same env ("pro": the users); "discard" drops that whole draft. More: neblla_get_llms tools/edit_file

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

edits.description: List of { oldText, newText, replaceAll? }; newText "" deletes.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

message.description: Note naming this version in neblla_versions.

path.description: Path of the text file, e.g. "client.js".

name: neblla_edit_file
title: Edit an app file
